title: Independent test of Pt-modulated HMF adsorption on Ni(111)
difficulty_reasons: Requires multi-start adsorption candidate discovery, deduplication and validated transition-path searches on two metallic slabs.
The paper omits complete coordinates and several numerical settings, so reproducibility requires explicit independent model and sensitivity justification.
